questions.question: How has Kenjaku been able to keep living for over a thousand years?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: Using their innate technique to swap bodies with other people by transplanting their brain, Kenjaku was able to live on throughout the ages, seemingly for no other purpose than fulfilling their intellectual curiosity.

questions.question: How did Kenjaku come to possess Suguru Geto's body?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: In 2017, Suguru Geto was killed by Satoru Gojo. Using his cursed technique, Kenjaku put his brain in Suguru’s body and took over.

questions.question: Why did Kenjaku offer Jogo the Prison Realm?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: Since Gojo cannot be killed or beaten, Kenjaku offers up the high-grade cursed object, the Prison Realm as a solution.

questions.question: How did Kenjaku and Mahito plan to force Yuji into a binding vow with Sukuna?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: The plan being that if Junpei and Yuji fight it will force Yuji to make a binding vow with Sukuna, which would help them convince Sukuna to work with them.

questions.question: Why was the Sukuna finger in Junpei's class important to Kenjaku's plan?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: The finger left in Junpei’s course would be taken by Jujutsu High, was vital to this plan as they planned a seal on it so they could track it’s location to the hidden store room.

questions.question: What did Kenjaku and Mahito do with the Death Womb Painting curses?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: Kenjaku and Mahito would implant the Death Womb Painting curses into human hosts, letting the spirits fuse and possess them.

questions.question: Why did Kenjaku plan to fight Gojo in the Shibuya subway?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: As Gojo is more stronger in open areas, they plan to fight him in the underground subway surrounded by hundreds of people.

questions.question: Who did Choso discover 'Suguru Geto' really was?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: Choso finally realizes Geto’s true identity, his monstrous father: Kenjaku.

questions.question: What did Kenjaku say would happen if Japan's non-sorcerers merged with Tengen?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: he explains that Tengen will become like a cursed spirit upon evolving, and that if Japan's non-sorcerers merged with them, a cursed spirit with all their cursed energy would be created, perhaps even capable of extraction like Uzumaki.

questions.question: How did Kenjaku survive Yuki Tsukumo's black hole attack?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: Kenjaku however survives by using the late Kaori's innate technique, Anti-gravity System.

questions.question: Why was Kenjaku unable to detect Yuta Okkotsu before the final blow?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: Upon reflection, Kenjaku realized that the reason he was not able to detect Yuta in the first place was because of Takaba.

questions.question: What was Kenjaku's backup plan as he was dying?
questions.subject: Kenjaku/Synopsis

answer.item: Kenjaku then decides to act on his backup plan adding a rule to the culling game giving the authority to activate the merger with Tengen and humanity to Megumi (who is possessed by Sukuna).
